title: 2491. Divide Players Into Teams of Equal Skill

examples.explanation: Divide the players into the following teams: (1, 5), (2, 4), (3, 3), where each team has a total skill of 6. The sum of the chemistry of all the teams is: 1 * 5 + 2 * 4 + 3 * 3 = 5 + 8 + 9 = 22.
The two players form a team with a total skill of 7. The chemistry of the team is 3 * 4 = 12.
There is no way to divide the players into teams such that the total skill of each team is equal.
